action.new_text:
"""Return leading spectral coordinates for a cell-by-feature count matrix."""
    if not isinstance(counts, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("counts must be a numpy ndarray")
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts contain nonfinite values")
    if (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts contain negative values")
    row_sums = counts.sum(axis=1)
    if (row_sums == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts contain all-zero rows")
    n_cells = counts.shape[0]
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be between 1 and n_cells-1 inclusive")
    sqrt_row_sums = np.sqrt(row_sums)
    B = counts / sqrt_row_sums[:, np.newaxis]
    np.random.seed(random_state)
    U, s, Vt = sp.linalg.svds(B, k=n_components, which='LM')
    eigenvalues = s ** 2
    embedding = U
    return eigenvalues, embedding
